dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you know anything about the Fatui...

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: Why are you asking me? I've got nothing in common with those cowa... Ahem, I mean, those mask-wearing creeps who skulk around all day.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: Or did you hear some droll rumors accusing me of being a Snezhnayan spy? Pff. You'd be underestimating the Snezhnayan intelligence agencies, and you'd be underestimating me.

dialogues.speaker: Golitsyna
dialogues.text: Anyways. They do their dirty work, and I do my business. That's all. Don't go lumping us together just because we're both from Snezhnaya.
